raw_segments.text: Lear, pray, do not mock me.
I am a very foolish, fond old man, forescore and upward, not an hour more nor less, and
to deal plainly I fear I am not in my perfect mind.
Me thinks I should know you and know this man, yet I am doubtful, for I am mainly ignorant
what place this is, and all the skill I have remembers not these garments, nor I know not
where I did lodge last night.
Do not laugh at me, for, as I am a man, I think this lady to be my child Cordelia.
